beats.label: SAY
beats.note: What's one thing you could try?

copy.caption: When “I'm bored” hits, you don't have to be the entertainment director. Try: “What's one thing you could try?” They choose, and the plan is theirs. Free Parent Script Cards: link in bio.
copy.pin_title: What to Say When Your Child Says “I'm Bored”
copy.pin_desc: A simple parent script for “I'm bored”: ask “What's one thing you could try?” so your child picks the plan and you stop being the entertainment director. Part of the Julia Redmond executive function series for parents of kids 9-13. Free Parent Script Cards available from Julia Redmond Publishing.
